## Activity

Oakridge Primary Care recorded 55 captures during December 2021. Activity proceeded as expected, with session lists running as planned apart from routine leave. The available activity record indicates that the site maintained its scheduled service during the month. No other operational variation was identified in the information reviewed.

The total of 55 captures represents the activity submitted for assessment from Oakridge Primary Care in December 2021. This figure is used as the basis for the image quality and grading results reported below.

## Image quality

Of the 55 captures, 2 were ungradable. This represents an ungradable rate of 3.6 per cent. The remaining captures were available for grading. The ungradable images are reported separately so that the quality result is clear and can be considered alongside the grading outcome.

## Grading

Grading identified 7 referable results. The median lag from capture to grading was 13 days. This is the median interval recorded for the month and provides an overall measure of the time taken for results to progress from capture to grading. Together, the activity, image quality and grading figures summarise operations at Oakridge Primary Care during December 2021.
